description: This header file declares functions related to the 'Parodus' client, including functions to retrieve hardware MAC address, partner ID, reboot reason, and firmware name. It includes conditional declarations for testing purposes with GTest.

methods.name: get_HWMAcAddress
methods.description: Function to retrieve the hardware MAC address, available when GTEST_ENABLE is defined.

methods.name: get_PartnerId
methods.description: Function to retrieve the partner ID, available when GTEST_ENABLE is defined.

methods.name: get_RebootReason
methods.description: Function to retrieve the reboot reason, available when GTEST_ENABLE is defined.

methods.name: get_FwName
methods.description: Function to retrieve the firmware name, available when GTEST_ENABLE is defined.
